title: Detect and Remove Loop in Linked List
problemStatement: Given the head of a singly linked list, determine whether the list contains a cycle. If a cycle exists, remove the loop without losing any nodes and return the head of the modified linked list. If no loop exists, return the original linked list.
input: A linked list. The testing system may internally create a cycle.
output: The linked list after removing the loop.
constraints: Number of nodes is in the range [0, 10^5]
